term: worldwise presence with separately chosen times
definition: Worldwise h x means ∀ w, ∃ t, h.IsAt w x t, for a fixed bearer x and History W B T with a shared time carrier T. World and time quantifiers are unrestricted; no modal accessibility, coherence with Ontic.ExistsAt or temporal order is implicit.
